payload.title: Move the lab's OpenAI provider secret from Secrets Manager to SSM SecureString
payload.description: Ryan's standing rule (2026-10-21, relayed by the Prospectus session): use SSM Parameter Store standard SecureString parameters (free) for secrets and config; Secrets Manager only where a service requires it. cyclotron-production (682849160744) has one secret, cyclotron/providers/openai, granted to WorkerRole (GetSecretValue on cyclotron/providers/openai-??????) in infra/lab/template.yaml. Move it to a SecureString read with GetParameter WithDecryption (cached), IAM scoped to the exact parameter ARN, referenced from IaC (nothing configured by hand; Ryan enters the value). Cut over via a reviewed change set; delete the old secret only after cutover with Ryan's approval.
